Instrumentation Set

LawtonElite Skull Base Instrumentation Set

Ref: LE-SKB-SET • 15 instruments • Stainless steel tray

  • Skull Base
  • Craniotomy
  • Keyhole
  • Deep Cavernous Malformation

A curated set of precision instruments for skull base surgery, developed in collaboration with Dr. Michael Lawton. Supplied in a sterilizable stainless steel tray with individual instrument holders.

Total instruments15 (21 pieces including multiples)
Tray material316L stainless steel
Tray dimensions340 x 240 x 40 mm
SterilizationSteam autoclave or ETO
Custom configurationsAvailable on request
